title: Pre-Analysis (Closed) — Vacuum Toilet Interface Seal, Cabin Retrofit Packaging
abstract: Closed pre-analysis of whether the bowl interface retrofit could be packaged with a cabin refresh programme for one operator, delegated to the cabin definition office once the technical questions were answered.

sections.objective: Establish whether the bowl interface seal and latch retrofit could be embodied inside an operator's cabin refresh rather than as a standalone bulletin, and whether anything in the refresh scope would conflict with it.
sections.findings_summary: Three items were confirmed and none blocking. The retrofit is a monument-level task that does not touch the aeroplane structure, so it fits inside a refresh with no additional approval. The servicing task needs the latch force gauge, which the refresh contractor does not hold and would have to be supplied. The parts figure would need its effectivity recorded aircraft by aircraft rather than by bulletin, because a refresh does not produce a bulletin record entry, and that was the item that took the time. The technical answer was straightforward and the packaging decision belonged to the cabin definition office rather than to engineering.
sections.next_steps: Delegated to the cabin definition office with the tooling and record-keeping conditions attached. No engineering change was raised.

similarity_seeds: work embodied inside a refresh that produces no bulletin record

tasks.title: Confirm the retrofit stays at monument level
List the tooling the refresh contractor would need

expected_findings.rationale: Embodiment inside a refresh produces no bulletin accomplishment record, so the aircraft would carry the post-modification standard with no traceable entry against the bulletin.
expected_findings.resolution: Record embodiment aircraft by aircraft in the configuration record, and state it in the refresh specification.

expected_findings.rationale: The servicing task requires the latch force gauge on modified aircraft and the refresh contractor does not hold that tool.
expected_findings.resolution: Add the gauge to the refresh tooling list.

expected_findings.rationale: The pre and post item pair is keyed to the modification, and a refresh embodiment has to update the configuration record for the figure to be read correctly afterwards.
expected_findings.resolution: Include the configuration record update in the refresh close-out.

type_data.conclusion: Closed and delegated to the cabin definition office with tooling and record-keeping conditions.
